header.title: 3x3x3 patterns
header.subtitle: Pick a pattern and apply the moves from a solved cube

the-superflip.name: The Superflip
the-superflip.description: Every corner solved and all 12 edges flipped, the single most scrambled state a cube can be in, exactly 20 moves from solved.

the-easy-checkerboard.name: Checkerboard
the-easy-checkerboard.description: Every face becomes a checkerboard of two opposite colors using only slice moves.

speedsolving-logo.name: SpeedSolving Logo
speedsolving-logo.description: Recreates the header logo of the SpeedSolving.com community website.

3sidessolved.name: 3 Sides Solved
3sidessolved.description: Three whole faces stay solved while the rest of the cube looks scrambled.

all-flags-and-crest.name: Flags & Crest
all-flags-and-crest.description: Three bands of color with a crest in the middle, like a tricolor national flag.

wire.name: Wire
wire.description: Thin diagonal lines of color stretch across each face like taut wires.

checkerboard-in-the-cube.name: Checkerboard in the Cube
checkerboard-in-the-cube.description: A checkerboard motif nested inside a smaller cube on every face.

perfect-scramble.name: Perfect Scramble
perfect-scramble.description: Every color appears on every face with no two matching stickers touching, the most evenly mixed scramble possible.

perfect-storm.name: Perfect Storm
perfect-storm.description: A dense, chaotic mix of colors on every face, discovered by Mugur.

minority-cross.name: Minority Cross
minority-cross.description: Every color appears on every face with the corners left solved and no two matching cross colors adjacent.

perpendicular-lines.name: Perpendicular Lines
perpendicular-lines.description: Straight lines cross at right angles on each face.

flipped-tips-yeah.name: Flipped Tips
flipped-tips-yeah.description: The corner pieces look twisted in place while the rest of the faces stay clean.

plus-minus.name: Plus Minus
plus-minus.description: A plus sign on two opposite faces with horizontal stripes running around the sides.

tablecloth.name: Tablecloth
tablecloth.description: A checkered, cloth-like pattern drapes evenly over every face.

deckerboard.name: Deckerboard
deckerboard.description: A half-checkerboard variant where only part of each face alternates colors.

spiral-pattern.name: Spiral
spiral-pattern.description: Color trails curl outward from the center of each face like a spiral.

fruit-bowl.name: Fruit Bowl
fruit-bowl.description: A cheerful mix of colored blocks scattered across the faces like fruit in a bowl.

flower-with-stem.name: Flower
flower-with-stem.description: A flower-shaped blossom with a stem appears on each face.

vertical-stripes.name: Vertical Stripes
vertical-stripes.description: Vertical stripes wrap around the four side faces while the top and bottom stay solid.

gift-box.name: Gift Box
gift-box.description: A ribbon-like cross wraps each face as if the cube were wrapped like a present.

opposite-corners.name: Opposite Corners
opposite-corners.description: The corner pieces on opposite faces swap colors, framing each center in a contrasting border.

cross-2.name: Cross
cross-2.description: A cross in a contrasting color appears on all six faces.

four-crosses.name: 4 Crosses
four-crosses.description: Four of the six faces display a clean plus-shaped cross.

cross.name: Union Jack
cross.description: A diagonal cross pattern reminiscent of the United Kingdom's flag on opposite faces.

twisted-cube-in-the-big-cube.name: Cube in the Cube
twisted-cube-in-the-big-cube.description: Every face shows a smaller cube nested in one of its corners.

cube-in-a-cube-in-a-cube.name: Cube in a Cube in a Cube
cube-in-a-cube-in-a-cube.description: Three cubes nested one inside the other on every face.

anaconda.name: Anaconda
anaconda.description: A thick snake-like band of color slithers across the faces.

python.name: Python
python.description: A winding, segmented trail of color slithers across the cube like a snake.

black-mamba.name: Black Mamba
black-mamba.description: A dark, narrow serpentine stripe coils across the faces.

green-mamba.name: Green Mamba
green-mamba.description: A different serpentine coil, a color variant of the mamba family of snake patterns.

tangled-cube.name: Tangled
tangled-cube.description: Interlocking bands appear knotted together across the faces.

four-spots.name: Four Spots
four-spots.description: The four side faces swap their centers while the top and bottom stay solid.

six-spots.name: Six Spots
six-spots.description: All six faces stay solid with a swapped center, forming six dots.

twister.name: Twister
twister.description: Bands of color appear to twist around each face like a wrung cloth.

kilt.name: Kilt
kilt.description: Overlapping stripes form a tartan-like pattern reminiscent of a Scottish kilt.

tetris.name: Tetris
tetris.description: Interlocking blocks of color, like falling Tetris pieces.

dont-cross-line.name: Don't Cross Line
dont-cross-line.description: A single straight line runs around the middle layer without ever crossing itself.

hi.name: Hi
hi.description: A short, friendly four-move sequence that leaves a simple greeting-like motif on the faces.

hi-all-around.name: Hi All Around
hi-all-around.description: The same friendly motif repeated so it shows up on every face.

spicy.name: Displaced Motif
spicy.description: Colors shift out of place just enough to create an irregular, spicy-looking mix.

hi-there.name: Are You High?
hi-there.description: A tall, symmetric motif stretches vertically across opposite faces.

see-you-around.name: C U Around
see-you-around.description: An irregular scramble-like pattern that still keeps a recognizable motif on each face.

order-in-chaos.name: Order in Chaos
order-in-chaos.description: A seemingly scrambled cube that still hides a recognizable repeating structure.

well-spread.name: Evenly Distributed
well-spread.description: Every face shows all six colors with no two of the same touching, spread out as evenly as possible.

the-hole.name: The Hole
the-hole.description: A short six-move sequence that leaves a hollow, empty-looking gap on the faces.

no-entry.name: No Entry
no-entry.description: A bold band of color rings each face like a road sign's no-entry stripe.

plus-apostr.name: Plus
plus-apostr.description: A simple plus sign appears centered on opposite faces.

3c3w.name: 3C3W
3c3w.description: Three corners and three wings of color rearrange to form a pinwheel-like motif.

pong.name: Pong
pong.description: Two small squares face off across the cube like paddles in a game of Pong.

spun-ts.name: Spun T's
spun-ts.description: T-shaped blocks of color appear rotated across the faces.

wifi-downstairs.name: Wifi Downstairs
wifi-downstairs.description: Concentric, signal-like bands radiate from the center of each face.

opposite-pillars-mem.name: Opposite Pillars
opposite-pillars-mem.description: Tall pillars of color stand on opposite faces of the cube.

viaduct-u.name: Viaduct
viaduct-u.description: A raised, bridge-like band of color arches across the faces.

2-small-cubes-in-scrambled.name: Solved in Scrambled
2-small-cubes-in-scrambled.description: Two small cubes stay intact with unmatched borders, hiding order inside an otherwise scrambled-looking cube.

hi-ohio-peace.name: Hi Ohio
hi-ohio-peace.description: A short, symmetric motif that reads the same from either side, like the palindrome "Ohio".

staircase-steps.name: Staircase
staircase-steps.description: Blocks of color descend across the faces like steps of a staircase.

wrapped2x2cube.name: Wrapped 2x2
wrapped2x2cube.description: The cube looks as if a smaller 2x2 cube were wrapped up and placed inside it.

antipodal-chaos.name: Antipodal Chaos
antipodal-chaos.description: Each face shows a different shape built from the colors of its opposite face.

flower-field-power.name: Flower Field
flower-field-power.description: A field of small flower-like blossoms spreads across every face.

c-spirals-3d.name: C Spirals
c-spirals-3d.description: C-shaped curves spiral outward from the center of each face.

tiny-worms-perpendicular.name: Worms
tiny-worms-perpendicular.description: Small worm-like trails of color crawl across the faces at right angles to each other.

glider-conways-life.name: Glider
glider-conways-life.description: A diagonal cluster of squares echoing the glider from Conway's Game of Life.

elegant-cube-in-cube.name: Quote
elegant-cube-in-cube.description: A neat, quotation-mark-like pair of blocks frames the corner of each face.

matching-pictures.name: Matching Pictures
matching-pictures.description: A short algorithm that leaves matching mirrored blocks of color on opposite faces.

loose-strap.name: Loose Strap
loose-strap.description: A loose band of color drapes diagonally across the top and bottom faces.

doubler.name: Doubler
doubler.description: A motif appears to repeat itself twice across the faces.

3t.name: 3T
3t.description: Three T-shaped blocks of color line up across the faces.

4t-around.name: 4 T
4t-around.description: Four T-shaped blocks appear, one on each side face.

6ts.name: 6 T
6ts.description: A T-shaped block of color appears on every one of the six faces.

zz-line.name: ZZ-Line
zz-line.description: A zigzagging line of color runs across the faces.

henrys-zigzag-with-checkerboard.name: Checker Zigzag
henrys-zigzag-with-checkerboard.description: A zigzag stripe cuts across a checkerboard background.

exchanged-duck-feet.name: Exchanged Duck Feet
exchanged-duck-feet.description: Y-shaped blocks that resemble webbed footprints swap places between faces.

stripe-dot-solved.name: Stripe Dot Solved
stripe-dot-solved.description: A short algorithm leaving a single stripe and dot while most of the cube stays solved.

picnic.name: Picnic
picnic.description: A tidy checkered pattern reminiscent of a picnic blanket, made in just five moves.

percent-sign.name: Percent Sign %
percent-sign.description: Diagonal blocks line up on each face to resemble a percent sign.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.description: Two opposite faces reflect each other's pattern like a mirror image.

plus-minus-check.name: Plus Minus Check
plus-minus-check.description: A checkered variant of the plus-minus pattern, alternating crosses and stripes.

facing-checkerboards.name: Facing Checkerboards
facing-checkerboards.description: Two opposite faces both turn into checkerboards that face each other.

hiagain.name: Hi Again
hiagain.description: A longer sequence that repeats the friendly "Hi" motif across every face.

4-plus-2-dots.name: 4 Plus 2 Dots
4-plus-2-dots.description: Four faces show a plus-shaped motif while the remaining two show simple dots.

rockets.name: Rockets
rockets.description: Triangular blocks of color point outward from the center like rockets taking off.

slash.name: Slash
slash.description: Diagonal slashes of color repeat evenly across the faces.

the-pillars.name: The Pillars
the-pillars.description: A minimal four-move sequence that leaves tall pillars of color on the side faces.

twisted-duck-feet.name: Twisted Duck Feet
twisted-duck-feet.description: A twisted variant of the duck-feet motif spreads across the faces.

rons-cube-in-a-cube.name: Ron's Cube in a Cube
rons-cube-in-a-cube.description: A cube-in-a-cube variant with a different color scheme, named after its creator Ron.

headlights.name: Headlights
headlights.description: Two bright squares of color sit side by side on a face like a car's headlights.

crossing-snake.name: Crossing Snake
crossing-snake.description: A serpentine trail of color crosses over itself as it winds across the faces.

toms-stripes.name: Cage
toms-stripes.description: Thin bars of color form a cage-like grid over each face.

4-crosses.name: 4 Crosses (Repeating)
4-crosses.description: A repeating six-move sequence that builds four crosses across the faces.

edge-hexagon-of-order-3.name: Pyraminx
edge-hexagon-of-order-3.description: Triangular blocks arrange into a hexagonal motif reminiscent of the Pyraminx puzzle.

edge-hexagon-of-order-2.name: Edge Triangle
edge-hexagon-of-order-2.description: A smaller triangular motif forms from the edge pieces of each face.

twisted-rings.name: Twisted Rings
twisted-rings.description: A repainted variant of the cube-in-a-cube-in-a-cube, with rings instead of squares.

exchanged-rings.name: Exchanged Rings
exchanged-rings.description: Ring-shaped blocks of color swap places between neighboring faces.

twisted-chicken-feet.name: Twisted Chicken Feet
twisted-chicken-feet.description: Y-shaped footprint blocks appear twisted across the faces.

exchanged-chicken-feet.name: Exchanged Chicken Feet
exchanged-chicken-feet.description: The chicken-feet motif swaps between opposite faces.

twinpeaks.name: Twin Peaks
twinpeaks.description: Two triangular peaks of color rise from each face.

four-twisted-peaks.name: Corner Pyramid
four-twisted-peaks.description: A pyramid-shaped block of color forms in the corner of each face.

two-twisted-peaks.name: Twisted Peaks
two-twisted-peaks.description: A pair of angular peaks twist across opposite faces.

exchanged-peaks.name: Exchanged Peaks
exchanged-peaks.description: The peak-shaped blocks trade places between opposite faces.

megatron.name: Megatron
megatron.description: A bold, angular motif spans the faces like a robot's armor plating.

six-two-one.name: Six-Two-One
six-two-one.description: A staged pattern where the faces show six, then two, then one block of color.

yin-yang.name: Yin Yang
yin-yang.description: Two interlocking curved halves of contrasting color form a yin-yang motif.

yan-ying.name: Yan Ying
yan-ying.description: A mirrored variant of the Tetris pattern, built from the same interlocking blocks turned the other way.

henrys-snake.name: Henry's Snake
henrys-snake.description: A snake-like trail of color winds across the faces, named after its creator Henry.

snake-eyes.name: Snake Eyes
snake-eyes.description: Two small dots of color sit side by side on each face like a pair of snake eyes on dice.

glitch-corners.name: Glitch
glitch-corners.description: The corners look slightly out of place, as if the cube glitched mid-scramble.

weirdo.name: Weirdo
weirdo.description: An irregular, asymmetric mix of colors that looks deliberately odd.

twisted-corners.name: Twisted Corners
twisted-corners.description: The corner pieces look rotated out of place across every face.

plus-with-dot.name: Quick Maths 1+1
plus-with-dot.description: A plus sign sits next to a single dot, a playful nod to simple arithmetic.

scrambled2x2s.name: Scrambled 2x2s
scrambled2x2s.description: The cube looks like four small 2x2 cubes, each individually scrambled.
